_how_to_use: A STARTING block for a 12 GB card, to be checked and tuned on that card: docs/SPEED_FIXES_SETUP.md, section 3a, "A 12 GB card". Copy the keys of "env" into the "env" object of your own strata-<model>.json (keep the keys it already has) and restart the server. This file is an example only and the server does not read it.
_not_measured: Nothing here was run on a 12 GB card. The values are computed from the loan sizes the engine logged on a 16 GB card with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL, for an expert cache of about 1,280 slots of 2.95 MiB. Read the real cache size from the engine log first and compute the chunk as section 3a says. If reads do not get faster, remove all three keys.
